verdict.rationale: Graphite's AI reviewer can be stopped from repeating unwanted feedback only through manually configured comment exclusions and custom rules (graphite-docs-20, graphite-docs-5), which the pricing page lists as an included customization (graphite-docs-33). Nothing shows the reviewer learning from a developer pushing back in the PR thread. Missing for 10: automatic learning from rejected or replied-to comments, evidence that pushback on a comment suppresses similar future comments, and hands-on corroboration.
